Hi Alice 

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment:

- SOC 2: You asked if Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report. We are currently SOC 2 Type II in scope with annual audits; our most recent report covers the period ending 2025-12-31. I can share the report under an NDA 

- GDPR/HIPAA: Redwood supports GDPR obligations (DPA available). For HIPAA we offer a BAA for enterprise/private deployments; our security team will route legal as needed.

- Encryption & KMS: We support in-transit TLS 1.2+ and AES-256 at-rest. For customer-managed keys (CMK) we provide:
  - AWS KMS integration (bring-your-own CMK)
  - Customer HSM integration via partner connectors (limited availability)
  - Option for a customer-managed envelope key where you control key rotation and we store only wrapped keys.
  Please let us know which of these you'd prefer to evaluate.

- Vendor questionnaire: You mentioned a standard security questionnaire 

- if you can send it, we'll start filling it out today.

Next steps I propose:
1) Alice to share the vendor security questionnaire and any required evidence list (e.g., pen test report, SOC 2).
2) Redwood to return a completed questionnaire and a redacted SOC 2 within 3 business days of receiving the form.
3) Schedule a short follow-up with our Security Solutions lead (Marissa) to walk through KMS deployment options 

- suggest Thu 3/5 or Fri 3/6.

Attachments: Redwood_KMS_Overview.pdf (overview, not full config), example-soc2-statement (redacted)

Thanks for the ping, Camila. I'll cover the CMK flow and logging in the technical deep-dive tomorrow. A couple of notes ahead of the call:

- Envelope encryption: we use a two-tier approach for customer-managed keys 

- a customer CMK (AWS KMS) wraps a per-tenant envelope key. This lets customers rotate their CMK without re-encrypting large datasets.
- Audit/logging: we emit KMS usage events to CloudTrail; account-level access is visible in our audit logs. We can provide redacted examples.
- HSMs: we support HSM-backed keys via partner integrations; will outline limitations and timeline.
